caption: The drawing depicts a single, diamond-shaped dish with gently curving sides, rendered in soft gray and brownish tones. The dish features a delicate border, traced in a light brown or gold color, which follows the contours of the dish. At the upper point of the diamond, there is a small decorative motif composed of stylized brown leaves, branches, and a simple white flower. Lighter brown floral patterns, resembling thin branches or vines with small leaves, extend outward from the decorative motif along the adjacent edges. The interior of the dish has a plain, light gray surface with subtle shading, suggesting its concave shape. Below the main depiction, there is a small, simple line drawing showing the dish from the top and side views in a minimalist style. On the left side of the lower section, there is a round stamp and on the right, the signature "Sudek" is written in cursive script. The drawings are centrally positioned on a plain beige background.
title: Saucer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
